description: PRO. All licensed devices matching a trade name (up to 200), with `licence_no`, `licence_end_date`, and `active` (derived from the end date: no end date, or an end date today or later, means active). Each row includes `match_type` (`exact`, `prefix`, or `partial`). Name searches can match the wrong device; when matches are not exact or come from several licences or companies, a top-level `warning` advises confirming with licence_detail using `licence_no`. Includes `retrieved_at` (ISO 8601 UTC) and `source_updated_at` (when the upstream Health Canada data was fetched, including cache hits).
name: device_search_full
